content: अम्बिका .²1 A mother, good woman, also used like अम्बा as a term of respect or endearment; अत्तिके अम्बिके शृणु मम विज्ञप्तिम् <ls>Mk. 1</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (अम्बा 2); <ab>N.</ab> of another plant कटुकी. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Pārvatī, wife of Śiva; आशीर्भिरेधयामासुः पुरः पाकाभिरम्बिकाम् <ls>Ku. 6. 90</ls>. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the middle daughter of Kāśīrāja and the eldest wife of Vicitravīrya. Like her youngest sister she had no progeny, and Vyāsa begot on her a son named धृतराष्ट्र. .²5 Name of a Jaina deity.
